scientific_protocol.forward: Variable-length layer Transformer encoder and RF patch cross-attention Transformer decoder. Mean and bounded heteroscedastic std; exact zero-lag RF=1/std=0.
scientific_protocol.inverse: RF Transformer encoder, categorical finite-layer count, eight deterministic Transformer-conditioned affine couplings over 5K+1 active coordinates; inactive padding excluded from likelihood and Gaussian base.
scientific_protocol.prior: Uniform finite-layer count 2--16. 80% sediment mixture, 0.05--10 km basin depth, 1--4 sediment cells where count permits; variable crust cells, 35% LVZ when >=3 crust cells. H 13--79 km; density and constant Q nuisance parameters inferred. See sample_prior for exact mixture. Fixed elastic halfspace Vp=8, Vs=4.5, rho=3.3. P shift U(-.29,.29). Accepted physical RF amplitude <=8 defines explicit simulator prior truncation; no benchmark truth involved.
scientific_protocol.coordinates: K thickness, Vs, Vp/Vs, rho, Qs per finite layer + P time shift: 5K+1. Thickness >=.02, H between 12 and 80, Vs .3--4.3, ratio >1.55 and Vp<8.8, rho 1.6--3.2, Qs 10--1000. Density in these physical coordinates requires subtracting decode log Jacobian from u-coordinate log probability.

rf.normalization: divide every event ray by its own RF P sample before bin averaging

scientific_protocol.noise: Known base sigma logU(.005,.025) per ray bin. Time-dependent multiplier .6+.4*abs(clean)/(.1+abs(clean)). Marginal covariance .85 RBF(.35 s)+.15 I, conditioned to zero at P. 80% shared band variance, 20% independent band variance. Each clean training RF gets fresh online noise; validation/test noise fixed with disjoint RNG streams. Generated std cap .03 RF units. These noise assumptions require separate real-data validation.
scientific_protocol.training: Forward: 20*clean-MSE+5*first-difference-MSE, then ramp .1*beta-NLL(beta=.5)+.01*supervised log-std-MSE after five mean-only epochs. Inverse: joint count/continuous negative log density on exact physical RF plus augmentation. No forward-emulator RF is used to train the inverse. Gradient clipping 1, finite checks, cosine schedule, float32. No heteroscedastic head can enlarge the specified simulator observation noise.
scientific_protocol.split: Independent SeedSequence(data_seed,split,shard), disjoint source IDs; all noise views stay with source. Shared slowness microbatch clusters recorded. Pilot data are independent training-only; test never selects weights.
scientific_protocol.selection: Full-data forward best clean validation RMSE after heteroscedastic weight reaches one (for runs >10 epochs); inverse best joint validation NLL. Pilot and bootstrap checkpoints have separate directories and do not qualify as final results.
scientific_protocol.scope: Amortized posterior approximation under declared synthetic prior, 1D GRTM and specified noise; not calibrated real posterior, arbitrary unseen layer-count accuracy, or demonstrated superiority to HMC.

execution.engine: FP32 CUDA graph forward/backward/clipping; ordinary AdamW; scalar step counters on CPU; finite checks before every update

scope: Independent accelerated training experiment using referenced, audited physical data. Statistical model/loss/batch/noise unchanged. Short runs are execution checks, not evidence of scientific accuracy.
